note: Port-only foundation units from porting/IMPLEMENTING.md section 4.3. Each is built, tests first, before the first Swift unit that uses the API it replaces; a Swift unit depends on a foundation unit when its source matches one of the unit's patterns. Tests carry Rule or Decision traits (no requirement ids).

units.spec: Path identity: appendingPathComponent, deletingLastPathComponent, pathExtension, standardizedFileURL, .path, absoluteness, normalization, containment. Implements ED-019, ED-026, ED-036, ED-038, ED-039, ED-045 as one predicate and one normalization; rule R-PATH-1. First tests: the cases each ED lists; drive letters, UNC, \\?\ prefixes, a bare backslash, trailing separators.
URL(string:): the macOS 14 leniency, host case and brackets, decoded path (R-PATH-1). First tests: "foo bar", IPv6 hosts, MarkdownView.swift:677.

ICU formatters through Windows icu.dll (ED-073): udat skeletons, ureldatefmt, unum spell-out, currency, Int.formatted(); ByteCountFormatter from its documented rules (R-FMT-2). First tests: the O-23 fixtures, marked Oracle until settled.

Process launcher: ADR-0002 CreateProcessW with a Job Object and ConPTY in one attribute list (probe P5), the three termination shapes of probe P6 (1 s, 3 s, none); PA-0007, PA-0008, PA-0009, PA-0010, PA-0016; ED-020, ED-024, ED-027, ED-047; rules R-PROC-1 to R-PROC-3. First tests: the ladders under the manual clock; environment block order; argument quoting round trip; the 32,767 character command-line limit.

File operations: PA-0015 retried replace, rename and delete under Windows sharing violations, read-only clearing, atomic write, verification (R-FS-1). First tests: a handle held open while the helper retries under the manual clock.

Production settings store behind the UserDefaults seam of ED-079: a per-user JSON store under the Marrow Code data folder (OD-0008 C7), keys and defaults exactly as the source names them, absent versus present kept distinct, integer(forKey:), double(forKey:) and bool(forKey:) conversions as Foundation performs them, atomic writes through F.FileOps. First tests: absent versus present, key names, write order, the type conversions.

Secret store in Windows Credential Manager (OD-0008 B3, ADR-0002 deviation 8; R-SEC-1): trimming, empty means delete, the Boolean result the Keychain helpers return, never a plain-text fallback (OD-0008 A6). First tests: trimming, empty deletes, the Boolean result, a refused write reports false.
HTTP client matching URLSession as the source uses it (R-NET-1): inactivity timeout, decompression, redirects, status handling, the User-Agent of OD-0012 F1. First tests: a loopback server.
Frame clock (ED-083; R-VIEW-10): frame-driven work runs on Avalonia's frame clock, the system timer resolution is never changed. First tests: a manual frame source.

File-system watcher (R-GCD-3): events posted to the main actor, overflow means rescan (probe P8: FileSystemWatcher.Error with InternalBufferOverflowException maps to everything = true / changed = nil), coalescing. First tests: a real temporary folder, including a forced overflow.

Source scan (ED-076; the list in IMPLEMENTING.md section 5.2): one test per test project scans its layer's src folder as text, outside Port/, for the banned patterns, with the protected allowlist. First tests: planted violations are caught.
